- reg-caps@ldo_3v3: 见 notes(惯例值)
- thermal@ldo_3v3: Tj≈136°C(裕量-30°C)
- fuse-rating@usb_c: I_hold≥0.15A(自恢复 PPTC 按此档)
- led-resistor@led_pwr: 推荐 270(就近换表内值)
